title: Package Format Snapshot
description: Immutable package-time snapshot of one selected Product format declaration. Product-format fields remain flattened at the root for 3.x compatibility; product, placement, exact execution-version, and digest fields bind the seller's package-time decision. A contract-bearing snapshot is durably identified even when no preview or observation feature is offered.

product_id.description: Product whose effective selected format was snapshotted. Required whenever tracker_execution_contract is present.

placement_refs.description: Nonempty, duplicate-free effective placement set, sorted by publisher_domain then placement_id using ascending UTF-8 bytes without Unicode normalization. Omission binds the product-wide common effective contract; it never means an inferred list of all current placements.

execution_vast_version.description: Exact VAST execution version selected for first-class VAST tracker matching when no sibling delivery document supplies one. The value is immutable for the package.

execution_daast_version.description: Exact DAAST execution version selected for first-class DAAST tracker matching when no sibling delivery document supplies one. The value is immutable for the package.

tracker_execution_contract_digest.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for tracker_execution_contract alone. Required if and only if the snapshot contains that contract.

product_snapshot_digest.description: Immutable SHA-256 digest of the package format snapshot's closed product-binding preimage. Required for every contract-bearing snapshot and paired with product_id whenever present.

verifier_constraints.tracker_execution_contract_digest: lowercase-hex SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON of tracker_execution_contract alone, with transmitted values and no materialized defaults
verifier_constraints.product_snapshot_digest: lowercase-hex SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the closed object {product_id, format, placement_refs?, execution_vast_version?, execution_daast_version?, tracker_execution_contract_digest?}; format contains every transmitted ProductFormatDeclaration field and excludes every package-only field
verifier_constraints.placement_order: placement_refs sorted by publisher_domain then placement_id using ascending transmitted UTF-8 bytes without Unicode normalization
verifier_constraints.execution_version: when a first-class VAST or DAAST tracker selector has no sibling exact-version delivery document, the matching execution_*_version is required and belongs to the selected option acceptance set
verifier_constraints.immutability: changing selected format, placement set, execution version, or tracker contract requires a replacement package_id; never mutate this snapshot in place
